title: Receipt body
description: The institution's answer to a purchase (credits.md 4.3, CR-6). Signed by the purchase's institution; prev is the purchase's id and the purchase has at most one receipt. A refund returns at most the price less the burned part, from the payees and the Treasury by the split in reverse. Credits are accounting entries, not money.

delivered_ref.description: What was given (an enrolment id, an item id).
